verdict.rationale: Bun's docs say v1.2 made the text-based `bun.lock` the default lockfile, and the homepage advertises 'a lockfile you can read', so an agent can read and diff it as plain text. However, the evidence never documents the lockfile's structure or schema and never addresses diffing or reviewing it, so only part of the story is shown. missing for 10: a documented lockfile format or schema specification, explicit evidence of diff or code-review friendliness, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent readability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at a documented, text-based lockfile format it can read and diff

citations.quote: Bun v1.2 changed the default lockfile format to the text-based `bun.lock`.
